_source: Watched in the built-in browser 2026-11-18 (Professor Of AI, 17M views, 2 months old; Hindi with a YouTube auto-dub track). Frames every 2-4 s plus a 0.3 s burst at 42 s; sound measured with the yt-style probe over 62.7 s. Shots are approximate from sampled frames and the probe's picture cuts. Our own descriptions.

hook.firstFrame: a dim night temple courtyard heaped with thousands of sandals; one man clutches his head in the pile while another stands holding a phone; a red label box at the top and a chatbot logo bottom-right
hook.firstLine: Someone used a chatbot to fix the lost-sandals-at-the-temple problem

shots.picture: 3D skit, wide: sandal-heaped courtyard, a man panics hands on head, hoodie guy with phone in foreground
over-shoulder of hoodie guy, the other man on all fours digging through the pile
the presenter in a home studio talking to camera with a microphone
wide: many identical orange-silhouette people bent over searching the heap, hoodie guy watching
low angle: orange figures crawling through the sandal heap
an orange figure gives up and walks off barefoot past a railing
presenter talking to camera, hand gestures
hoodie guy standing in the pile, brick wall behind, other searchers in the back
rapid cuts: over-shoulder onto his phone showing an old photo of his clogs
top-down on the phone in his hand: the photo uploaded into the chat app
hoodie guy at the railing holds the phone up to film the whole heap
back view, guy holding phone; the chatbot logo pops in and floats above the phone
a huge glowing blue hemisphere scans across the heap from his phone, a pink label floats above it
a photo inset of the clog on gravel appears top-left over the scan dome
scan dome keeps pulsing, guy holds phone up, camera high and wide
close-up of the phone: the chatbot's answer naming where the clogs are, a finger on it
the guy walks to a shoe rack by the wall and reaches toward one pair
wide: guy beside the rack, his pair glows red among the pile

lines.gist: a man used a chatbot to solve the classic lost-footwear-at-the-temple problem
the presenter says what happened and that it is clever
his clogs vanished into a mountain of shoes outside the temple
normally you search for hours or walk home barefoot
instead he tried something new with technology
he uploaded an old photo of his clogs so the bot knew the exact design
then he filmed the whole heap for the bot to search
a vision feature scanned every pair looking only for that one design
within seconds it told him the exact spot, on the rack to the right
he walked over and got his clogs back

ending.lastFrame: wide shot of the man beside the shoe rack, his pair glowing red in the heap

whyItWorks: an everyday pain everyone in the audience has felt, shown as a skit in the first frame with a panicking man
a gag beat early: faceless orange extras crawl and one walks home barefoot, cheap crowd acting that reads instantly
the AI is made physical: a giant glowing scan dome sweeps the pile, so an invisible process becomes a picture
the found object glows red at the end, a clear visual payoff for the problem set up in frame one
